source_credits.role: Painting [Of The Pianist, Mrs. Rubinstein, Eva And Paul]

entries.source_notes:
This is the first US stereo version, released in a gatefold sleeve and with an accompanying 20-page booklet.
[url=http://www.discogs.com/release/3508780]Later versions[/url] had a single sleeve and/or a different sleeve design.

LABELS:
- Red/silver 'Shaded Dog' labels
- Deep 'groove' in label area
- "Living Stereo" at bottom of label
- "Stereo-orthophonic..." text below Nipper
- Rim text at bottom of label starts with "Trade marks"
- "Made in U. S. A." in rim text

SLEEVE:
- Heavy cardboard gatefold sleeve, not laminated
- The LP and the booklet are inserted from the inside
- Large "Living Stereo" banner on front top
- "©RCA Printed in U. S. A." on front
- Back of the sleeve shows a drawing, no sleeve notes

BOOKLET:
- 20 pages, full size
- Contains biographical notes on Rubinstein, notes about the Chopin works and a Rubinstein discography
- The last page has an "Important" stereo info sticker attached
- "© by Radio Corporation of America, 1959"
- "Printed in U. S. A."

CATALOG NUMBERS:
- LSC-2265 on front of sleeve and on top of spine
- LSC 2265 on labels and on bottom of spine

OTHER INFORMATION:
- Recorded 20 January 1958 at Carnegie Hall, New York
- Labelography code: UE4
- Corresponding mono issue has cat# [url=http://www.discogs.com/release/582721]LM-2265[/url]
